How it works

From used oil to useful fuel.

Four controlled stages turn recovered oil into a tested industrial product, ready for your plant and backed by the right paperwork.

  1. 01

    Collect

    Used oil comes in.

    Collected from authorised sources and moved in sealed containers.

  2. 02

    Re-refine

    Impurities come out.

    Filtering, dehydration and distillation remove water and contaminants.

  3. 03

    Test

    Every batch is checked.

    Quality is verified against recognised methods and documented in a COA.

  4. 04

    Deliver

    Your schedule keeps moving.

    Product is dispatched by tanker or barrel with a GST invoice.
